# IH Tech

> A small team of AI experts that join yours. Technical authority, embedded delivery, AI enablement and agent architectures for teams in the EU, North America and the Middle East.

IH Tech is a software agency based in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Contact: info@ihtech.ba

## What we do

- **Technical authority** — We take the senior seat on the calls that are expensive to get wrong — feasibility, architecture, sequencing — and give you an answer you can act on rather than a deck.
- **Part of your core team** — We embed. Your programme, your backlog, your standards — with senior people in it who have done the hard version before, and who are accountable for shipped work rather than advice.
- **Enabling your teams** — The goal is that your engineers do this without us. We run the workshops, set the standards, and put the evaluation practice in place that makes AI-assisted delivery measurable instead of anecdotal.
- **Agentic product development** — We design agent systems that do real work: separated planning, implementation and review roles, wired into the systems a business already runs. Discovery moves in days.
- **Platform and tooling** — The leverage is usually in the tool nobody has built yet — migration tooling, evaluation platforms, and internal assistants wired into systems a company already pays for.
